mapper.insert: insert into ai_kb_doc (project_id, stage, title, source_type, original_text, chunk_count, status, create_by) values (#{projectId}, #{stage}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{originalText}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{createBy})
mapper.update: update ai_kb_doc set chunk_count = #{chunkCount} where doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_kb_doc where project_id = #{projectId} and stage = #{stage} and source_type = 'pipeline'
delete from ai_kb_chunk where project_id = #{projectId} and stage = #{stage}
mapper.insert:
insert into ai_kb_chunk (doc_id, project_id, stage, seq, content, tags, tokens, status) values
(#{item.docId}, #{item.projectId}, #{item.stage}, #{item.seq}, #{item.content}, #{item.tags}, #{item.tokens}, #{item.status})
mapper.select: select * from ai_kb_chunk where (project_id = #{projectId} or project_id = -1) and (stage = #{stage} or stage is null) and match(content, tags) against (#{query} in boolean mode) order by match(content, tags) against (#{query}) desc limit #{topK}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_kb_retrieval_log (project_id, stage, query_text, chunk_ids, model_id) values (#{projectId}, #{stage}, #{queryText}, #{chunkIds}, #{modelId})
